title: Austin Budget Focus: Police, Parks, Aviation
summary:
*   The Austin City Council held a special work session dedicated exclusively to reviewing the proposed budget for the 1987/88 fiscal year.
*   Discussions included budget proposals for critical public services like the Police Department and the Parks and Recreation Department.
*   Financial plans for Aviation (airport operations), Municipal Court, and other city departments were also presented.
*   This meeting was for departmental review and discussion only; no final budget decisions were made or public hearings conducted.
